title: Cardinal Billing Account Standing Rule: Eligibility Rate on the Prepayment Credit
content:
**Rule.** An eligibility rate multiplies the prepayment credit on a Cardinal Billing Account term payoff: none of it is given when two or more payments on the account were returned in the last 12 whole months, one half (0.5) when exactly one was, and all of it when none was.

A window of the last 12 whole months holds every record posted less than 12 whole months before the payoff date, counted on calendar months. A returned payment is a returned-payment entry on the account's billing history.

| Returned payments in the last 12 whole months | Share of the prepayment credit given |
|---|---|
| 0 | All of it |
| 1 | One half |
| 2 or more | None |

**Hypothetical cases.** A credit figured at $6.00 on an account with one returned payment in the window: $3.00 is given. With two returned payments in the window: no credit is given.
